features.description: Remove tracked secrets and unsafe artifacts from the tree, and add a secret-scanning guard (gitleaks) in pre-commit and CI, with an owner rotation list that names services only.
steps: Delete .devcontainer/.env from the tree with git rm --cached semantics (the file is never opened or printed by an agent).
Add .gitignore rules: .env, .env.*, **/.env, *.pkl, *.pickle, *.joblib, with !.env.example as the only exception.
Add .devcontainer/.env.example listing variable NAMES only, derived from os.environ/getenv references in code and devcontainer.json, never from the secret file.

Delete resources/tools/genetics/genetic_risk_predictor.pkl (main only); record in docs/decisions/ that it was removed because pickle loading executes arbitrary code and its provenance is unknown; grep confirms no code loads it, or replace the loader with an explicit error.

Add gitleaks to .pre-commit-config.yaml and a CI job (gitleaks/gitleaks-action pinned by commit SHA) that scans the PR diff and fails on findings; add a .gitleaks.toml with an allowlist limited to test fixtures.

Write .autodev/spec/secret-rotation.md for the owner: the services whose credentials may have been in the file (from variable names referenced in code/config), what rotating each one means, and who must do it.
Queue the history purge (git filter-repo + force-push on a public repo) as a separate owner decision in next-steps.md; never execute it.
acceptance: git ls-files on the PR head lists no .env file other than *.env.example and no *.pkl/*.pickle/*.joblib file.

gitleaks detect --no-git on the PR head reports zero findings; a throwaway test commit with a fake AWS-style key is blocked by the pre-commit hook and the CI secret-scan job command fails on it when run locally (evidence: both logs).
The CI gitleaks step is pinned by commit SHA (OpenSSF Scorecard 'Pinned-Dependencies' practice) and is a required check listed in the F003 protection request.
secret-rotation.md names services and owners only; a grep of it for high-entropy strings (gitleaks run over the file) finds nothing.
An ADR in docs/decisions/ (Context / Decision / Consequences, per NeuroIA protocol section 11) records the pickle removal and the 'no pickle in the package' rule.
PR body uses the sections What it does / Why / How to reproduce / Impact on results and lists the sensitive files touched.
Owner gate: the hosted secret-scan run on the published PR is green (prepared: PR text in contracts/F001-pr.md).
features.notes: No dependencies. Agents never read .devcontainer/.env (guard forbidden_paths). Rotation is done by the owner or account managers. History purge is a separate owner gate. Lands on main before the chain; F005 must carry the deletion into the reconciled tree because the chain still tracks .devcontainer/.env. features.description: Introduce a provenance contract that marks simulated output at the type level, and use it to label and disconnect every simulated component on main from decisions and public text.
steps: Target design: a frozen dataclass Provenance(kind: Literal['measured','computed','simulated','stub'], source: str, version: str) attached to every plugin/connector result; a SimulatedComponentWarning emitted on first use; a registry query list_simulated_components().

Apply it on main to: plugins/builtin/protein_generator.py and simple_optimizer.py (random), plugins/alpha_genome.py and alphafold.py (stubs), ir/external/openmed_connector.py (hash-derived entities; 'privacy_cleared': True without a filter), examples/real_project/execute_genesis_real.py.
OpenMed: replace the constant privacy_cleared=True with privacy_cleared=False plus provenance kind 'stub' until a real filter exists; document that no privacy guarantee is provided.
Any decision path (optimizer selection, gating, ranking) refuses simulated inputs unless the caller passes allow_simulated=True, and its output inherits kind='simulated'.
Write .autodev/system/components.md rows for each component: real / simulated / stub / dead, with the oracle needed to promote it to real.
acceptance: For each listed component, a unit test asserts result.provenance.kind in {'simulated','stub'} and that a SimulatedComponentWarning is raised.
A test asserts that the optimizer/decision entry points raise when given simulated inputs without allow_simulated=True.
No output of a simulated component contains a key named like a guarantee ('privacy_cleared': True, 'validated', 'calibrated') unless backed by a real check (grep test).
Provenance is typed (mypy --strict passes on the new module) and documented in the public API reference.
A replacement with a real implementation is recorded as future work only; nothing is promoted without access to the real service and an oracle test (owner decision 4).
